title: Certified Circuits: Stability Guarantees for Mechanistic Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2602.22968v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding how neural networks arrive at their predictions is essential for debugging, auditing, and deployment. Mechanistic interpretability pursues this goal by identifying circuits--minimal subnetworks responsible for specific behaviors. However, existing circuit discovery methods are brittle: circuits depend strongly on the chosen concept dataset and often fail to transfer out-of-distribution, raising doubts whether they capture the concept or merely dataset-specific artifacts. We introduce Certified Circuits, which provide provable stability guarantees for circuit discovery. Our framework wraps any black-box discovery algorithm with randomized data subsampling to certify that inclusion decisions over circuit components--neurons or edges of the model graph, depending on the base algorithm--are invariant to bounded edit-distance perturbations of the concept dataset. translated_title: 认证电路：机制电路的稳定性保证
translated_abstract: 理解神经网络如何得出其预测对于调试、审计和部署至关重要。机制可解释性通过识别“电路”——即负责特定行为的最小子网络——来追求这一目标。然而，现有的电路发现方法十分脆弱：电路高度依赖于所选的概念数据集，且往往无法在分布外迁移，这引发了人们的质疑：它们究竟捕捉到了概念本身，还是仅仅捕捉到了数据集特有的伪影。我们提出了认证电路，为电路发现提供可证明的稳定性保证。我们的框架通过随机化数据子采样来包装任意黑盒发现算法，以证明对电路组件（取决于基础算法，可以是神经元或模型图的边）的纳入决策在概念数据集的有界编辑距离扰动下保持不变。对于不稳定的组件将予以弃权，从而产生……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了“认证电路”框架，通过随机化数据子采样包装任意黑盒电路发现算法，为电路组件的纳入决策提供可证明的稳定性保证，使其对概念数据集的有界编辑距离扰动保持不变，并对不稳定组件予以弃权。
en_tdlr: Certified Circuits wraps any black-box circuit discovery algorithm with randomized data subsampling to provide provable stability guarantees, certifying that component inclusion decisions are invariant to bounded edit-distance perturbations of the concept dataset while abstaining from unstable components.
